title: Mathematics
description: ISC Class XI Mathematics: one theory paper of 3 hours carrying 80 marks plus 20 marks project work. Three-dimensional geometry, calculus and statistics foundations begin here.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ISC Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Mathematics (www.cisce.org), corroborated by Oswal Publishers' 2026-27 reproduction.
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Units: Sets and Functions; Algebra; Coordinate Geometry; Calculus; Statistics and Probability.

sections.title: Mathematics
sections.description: Five units from sets to probability.

chapters.title: Sets
chapters.blurb: Representations, subsets, Venn diagrams, operations and practical problems.

chapters.title: Relations and Functions
chapters.blurb: Ordered pairs, Cartesian product, relations, functions, domain/co-domain/range, and standard real-valued functions.

chapters.title: Trigonometric Functions
chapters.blurb: Radians, unit circle, signs, sin^2+cos^2=1, sum/difference and double-angle identities, graphs.

chapters.title: Complex Numbers
chapters.blurb: i and its powers, a+ib form, operations, conjugate, modulus, Argand plane, cube roots of unity.

chapters.title: Quadratic Equations
chapters.blurb: Quadratic formula, discriminant, nature of roots, sum and product of roots, reducible equations.

chapters.title: Linear Inequalities
chapters.blurb: Inequalities in one variable: algebraic rules, solution sets and number-line representation.

chapters.title: Permutations and Combinations
chapters.blurb: Fundamental principle of counting, factorial notation, permutations, combinations and their formulas, the connection between them, and simple applications.

chapters.title: Binomial Theorem
chapters.blurb: Expansion for positive integral index, Pascal's triangle, general and middle terms, and simple applications.

chapters.title: Sequences and Series
chapters.blurb: Arithmetic and geometric progressions, arithmetic and geometric means, infinite G.P. sum, and standard special sums.

chapters.title: Straight Lines
chapters.blurb: Slope, forms of equations, angle between two lines, conditions for parallel and perpendicular lines, and distance of a point from a line — the ISC Class XI coordinate geometry treatment of straight lines.

chapters.title: Circles
chapters.blurb: Standard and general equations, tangents and conditions.

chapters.title: Limits
chapters.blurb: Intuitive idea, algebra of limits, standard limits and trigonometric limits.

chapters.title: Derivatives
chapters.blurb: Derivative as rate of change, first principles, rules and standard results.

chapters.title: Statistics
chapters.blurb: Range, mean deviation, variance and standard deviation for ungrouped and grouped data.

chapters.title: Probability
chapters.blurb: Random experiments, sample spaces, events, mutually exclusive and exhaustive events, and probability of not, and and or.
